meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动展开多路调研并生成带引用综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要穷尽式多源调研并产出严谨报告
copy.tagline_en: Automate exhaustive multi-source research and produce cited reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-source deep research with a polished report

howto.what: Claude 会启动深度研究流程:同时派多个搜索任务去查代码库、网页、官方文档、开源项目;追着线索查到底;对争议说法会运行代码验证;最后给出带引用的综合报告(含图表),默认 PDF+DOCX 格式,交付前先做画面质检。
howto.when: 只在用户明确要求做研究时触发,例如说出“ulw-research”“deep research”等关键词,或要求 hyperdebate 式辩论研究;任何语言都可以。普通提问、调试、为写代码收集背景不会激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究一下这项技术的现状,要带引用和图表。
say.note: 会进入深度研究模式,默认产出 PDF/DOCX。

say.text: deep research:对比方案 A 与方案 B,争议点请用代码验证。
say.note: 会并行搜索并跑代码核验,再给结论。

say.text: hyperdebate 研究:把支持与反对远程办公的证据都查一遍。
say.note: 会安排多个批判视角质证后才出报告。

howto.what_en: When active, Claude starts parallel research workers across codebase, web, docs and OSS repos, follows leads until they run dry, proves contested claims with code, and writes a cited report (charts/Mermaid), defaulting to PDF/DOCX after visual QA.
howto.when_en: Only explicit research requests start it: “ulw-research”, “deep research”, or hyperdebate-style investigations, in any language. Ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering won't activate it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this topic; give citations and charts.
say_en.note: Starts full research mode; output defaults to PDF/DOCX.

say_en.text: Deep research: compare option A and B; verify disputed points with code.
say_en.note: Spawns parallel search and code checks before concluding.

say_en.text: Hyperdebate: gather evidence both for and against remote work productivity.
say_en.note: Assigns several critical perspectives before the report.
